name: Rita Welburn
role: Keeps Rita's, the pawn; Danny's fence and eyes
temper_why: shrewd, never says what a thing is worth; Danny's fence and eyes; never the police (CAST, 2.5.2)

card.who: She keeps Rita's, the pawnshop on the corner of Chapel Lane. Its window is lit late; she does her books at night.
card.speak: Hard, even, unhurried. Prices everything, people included.
card.life: Thirty years behind the grille. Since the docks went she has taken in more wedding rings than she can sell.
card.fire: Somebody pledged a warehouse padlock key with her the week after. She did not ask.
card.rivals: She will lend to anyone and owes nobody, which is how she likes it. Cammack's lads tried to sell her car stereos and she sent them off.
